title: Etsy Introduces Stricter Rules for AI Content in Listings
excerpt: Etsy is updating its policies to limit the amount of artificial intelligence-generated content and items on its marketplace platform.
body_html:
Etsy is implementing stricter guidelines regarding the use of artificial intelligence in product listings. The company aims to address a growing volume of AI-generated content on its platform.

According to the company, many active shoppers report difficulty identifying items that involve artificial intelligence content. Additionally, platform sellers have expressed concerns about their genuine work appearing next to listings that rely on such tools.

The policy updates are designed to clarify the rules around artificial intelligence usage and help maintain product clarity for buyers across the marketplace.
